reviewed_by: Claude review of the MCP JSON import/export backend and MCP probe error handling
reason: Adds mcp_import.py plus POST /mcp-servers/import, GET /mcp-servers/export and `nebula-core mcp import|export`. Imported mcpServers/VS Code servers become disabled, untrusted McpServerProfile records; ${VAR} values become env: references, literal credentials go to the vault/session store or are rejected, and replace resets trust and capabilities. test_mcp_import.py covers preview, apply, secret handling and rollback, invalid-entry messages, conflicts, export round trip, the API routes and the CLI. test_cli.py covers the CLI module the new commands were added to; the credential API test and OpenAPI contract test cover the shared credential store and the new routes' registration. The MCP probe now treats only JSON-RPC -32601 (method not found) as an optional-list miss instead of matching message text, and requests resources/prompts only when the server advertises them; test_mcp_probe.py covers both directions (non-standard messages no longer fail the probe, real errors mentioning 'not found' are no longer swallowed), and the two existing stdio/HTTP probe tests in test_harnesses.py cover unchanged discovery.
exclusions: No full suites. No frontend, native or Playwright coverage: there is no UI change yet (the import dialog waits on an approved Figma mockup). The existing MCP probe/harness suites are not affected because McpServerProfile and the probe service are unchanged. A real-Core run was done by hand: import through the API, probe refused until trusted, probe returned tools with an env: reference resolved from the host, replace reset trust, and the CLI previewed and exported.
